messages:
alex: heads up — my feature branch `feature/rate-limiter` started failing CI after a rebase to main. Failing job: `unit-tests-shard-3`
ci-bot: build 7890 failed on shard 3 — TestRateLimiterConcurrency (link: https://ci.redwood/build/7890) :x:
maria.dev: can you paste the failing log snippet? did you rebase any infra/mocks recently? :eyes:
alex: running locally the tests pass. only CI is red. failing snippet:
```
  E       AssertionError: expected 0.3 < 0.2
  tests/test_rate_limiter.py:143: in test_concurrent
  redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: Error 111 connecting to 127.0.0.1:6379
```
sam: hmm, smells like a timing/redis-mock flake after the async redis client bump in main. could be the rebase pulled an async shim. quick actions: rerun the job, or run the single test on CI image locally. i can bisect if rerun is still red.
jen: i did change the redis mock in PR #4521 (async shim + shorter sleep). possible timeout regression. try rerunning first, and if it stays red we should bisect between main@{20} and HEAD. also try a targeted pytest run: `pytest tests/test_rate_limiter.py::TestRateLimiterConcurrency -q --maxfail=1 -k concurrency` to see focused output.
alex: kicking a rerun now (requested by alex): https://ci.redwood/build/7890/rerun :thumbsup:
ci-bot: rerun queued by alex. job started.
ci-bot: rerun finished — failed again, same error (TestRateLimiterConcurrency) :frowning:
sam: okay can confirm priority for a bisect. alex — can you add `pip freeze` and `python --version` from the failing CI run to your PR, and paste the full pytest -q output? might be CI image drift (redis version or base image). i'll start a git bisect tomorrow morning if rerun stays flaky.
alex: added logs + `pip freeze` output to PR and linked the failing job: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4567 (commented with env details).
jen: if the bisect points at my mock change, i'll revert the change and open a follow-up that uses a more robust asyncio-friendly sleep/mocking approach.
maria.dev: thanks — i'll try to reproduce quickly on a fresh devcontainer using the same CI image. if anyone else can try a quick reproduce with the CI image (docker: redwood/ci:2026-03-01), please ping. otherwise will wait for sam's bisect tomorrow. :pray:
